title: Offline survey saved locally
steps: Airplane mode -> fill and save survey -> pull DB with run-as
expected_result: Row in surveys table with sync_status=PENDING and all answers

title: Saved survey survives app kill
steps: Save offline -> adb shell am force-stop -> reopen

title: Saved survey survives reboot
expected_result: Survey still pending; sync job still scheduled

title: Sync job scheduled when offline
expected_result: Job present with network constraint unmet

title: Force sync now
expected_result: Job runs; request seen in Charles

title: Sync on network restore
expected_result: Job runs within seconds; status becomes SYNCED with server_id stored

title: Server returns 500
steps: Charles Rewrite (Response Status = 500) or a Breakpoint edits the response to 500
expected_result: Row stays PENDING; WorkSpec back to ENQUEUED with run_attempt_count +1; backoff; no data loss

title: Server returns 429/503 with Retry-After
expected_result: App waits at least Retry-After before next attempt

title: Response lost after server saved data
steps: Charles drops response after request completes
expected_result: Retry produces already_synced not a duplicate

title: Network drops at 99% of photo upload
steps: Charles throttle 2G then disable network near end
expected_result: Upload restarts/resumes; survey not marked synced until photo confirmed

title: App killed during sync
steps: Start sync then adb shell am kill

title: Doze mode
steps: adb shell dumpsys battery unplug -> adb shell dumpsys deviceidle force-idle (then unforce and battery reset)
expected_result: Sync deferred then runs in maintenance window

title: Low storage while saving
steps: Fill disk with adb shell dd
expected_result: Clear error; existing data not corrupted

title: App update with DB migration
steps: Install old APK -> save offline -> install new APK
expected_result: Pending survey migrated and still syncs

title: Release build not debuggable
expected_result: Fails as expected; use debug or staging build for DB inspection

title: Upload longer than 10 minutes on 2G
steps: 3-5 MB photo with upload throttled to 30 kbps
expected_result: Upload completes via chunked/resumable upload or a foreground worker; not stopped by WorkManager's 10-minute limit and retried forever
tools: Charles / mitmproxy throttling + adb logcat WM-WorkerWrapper
